world.label: Cross-Border Bio-Surveillance Decision
world.summary: A partnership comprising four countries and a regional health network must decide by a deadline whether to activate a cross-border bio-surveillance early-warning system. Technical, legal, logistics and community groups send local concerns through their own channels to different members. Regular meetings can be slowed by concerns, settled issues can reopen, and members' support can become condition
